lengthLine.short: LENGTH — VERY CONCISE (HARD LIMIT): Keep the ENTIRE response to a MAXIMUM of 2–3 pages (roughly 900–1,300 words). Include only the essential components and the core reasoning, expressed crisply. Omit padding, repetition, background recital and over-elaboration. Keep every mandatory part of this document type, but state each point briefly. Do NOT exceed 3 pages under any circumstance.
lengthLine.otherwise: LENGTH — COMPREHENSIVE: Produce a thorough, exhaustive draft with NO length limit — use as many pages as the matter genuinely needs. Develop every issue fully, include all relevant components, clauses/paragraphs, reasoning and supporting detail, and leave nothing material unaddressed.
